lead.headline: Nasdaq Bets $100M on Tokenized Equities as India and SEBI Prove Wholesale Demand
lead.tldr: Institutional infrastructure for tokenized real-world assets is accelerating faster than retail DeFi, with regulated pilots in India and Nasdaq's Kraken investment signaling where the next phase of capital formation will occur.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, this week the signal from regulated tokenization pilots and traditional exchange incumbents drowned out the noise from yet another sidechain exploit, and the divergence tells us where to underwrite infrastructure bets for the next twelve months.

top_signals.title: Weekly Research Brief: $LAPTOP Flops, Liquid Looted, OpenAI's Fuzzy Math
top_signals.summary: A weekly research brief covering a massive $320 million exploit of the Bitcoin sidechain Liquid and a postmortem on a failed memecoin associated with Hunter Biden. It also touches upon controversies regarding OpenAI's mathematical capabilities.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The $320 million Liquid exploit and the Hunter Biden memecoin failure both illustrate that speculative and experimental layers remain fragile, which reinforces why institutional capital is pricing security and regulatory clarity above novelty.

top_signals.title: Liquid Network resumes block production after $320M exploit
top_signals.summary: Liquid Network has resumed block production following a massive $320 million exploit. While white hat hackers returned 3,400 BTC, approximately 598 BTC remains outstanding.
top_signals.why_it_matters: White hat recovery of 3,400 BTC demonstrates that exploit response infrastructure is maturing, but the 598 BTC still outstanding shows residual counterparty risk that institutional treasuries must model explicitly.

top_signals.title: US Republicans send ‘final’ CLARITY Act offer to DemocratsThe 635-page revised proposal includes Trump-backed ethics provisions and comes just two days before a key procedural vote.
top_signals.summary: US Republicans have submitted a revised 635-page proposal for the CLARITY Act to Democrats. The offer includes ethics provisions and arrives ahead of a critical procedural vote regarding digital asset regulation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The CLARITY Act's 635-page revised proposal with Trump-backed ethics provisions represents the most concrete legislative path to US digital asset classification, and its procedural vote timing means Q2 could reprice US exchange and custody valuations sharply.

top_signals.title: India's SEBI Demat 2.0 pilot debuts with over $100 million in tokenized bonds
top_signals.summary: India's SEBI has launched the Demat 2.0 pilot, enabling the issuance of tokenized corporate bonds. The pilot has already seen over $100 million raised across three issuers, utilizing a wholesale CBDC for settlement.
top_signals.why_it_matters: SEBI's Demat 2.0 pilot crossing $100 million in tokenized bonds with wholesale CBDC settlement proves that regulator-sanctioned tokenization can achieve real scale without retail speculation, establishing a template other jurisdictions will study.

top_signals.title: Blockstream rejects ransom as Liquid hackers hold nearly 600 BTC
top_signals.summary: Blockstream has refused to pay a ransom to hackers who exploited the Liquid network and are currently holding approximately 598 BTC. The company has explicitly rejected the attackers' claims of being 'white-hat' hackers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Blockstream's refusal to negotiate with attackers holding 598 BTC sets a precedent that ransom payments are not normalized in Bitcoin infrastructure, which hardens the security assumption for institutional sidechain users.

top_signals.title: Nasdaq bets big on tokenized stocks with $100 million investment in Kraken parent Payward
top_signals.summary: Nasdaq has invested $100 million into Payward, the parent company of Kraken, to advance the development of tokenized stocks. This strategic move reportedly brings Kraken's overall valuation to $21 billion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Nasdaq's $100 million investment in Kraken's parent at a $21 billion valuation validates tokenized equities as a strategic priority for incumbent exchanges, and the price itself signals competitive tension with traditional clearing infrastructure.

deals.summary: India's SEBI has launched the Demat 2.0 pilot, enabling the issuance of tokenized corporate bonds. The pilot has already seen over $100 million raised across three issuers, utilizing a wholesale CBDC for settlement.

TRM Labs has doubled its valuation to $2 billion following an expansion of its Series C funding round. The company provides blockchain intelligence and risk management tools to help institutions and regulators combat financial crime.

Latitude, a startup founded by former Stripe and Uber employees, has raised $35 million to bridge the gap between stablecoin transfers and local spending. The company aims to enable the seamless conversion of digital assets into usable local payments.

Robinhood has acquired stakes in Crypto.com and OG.com as part of a strategic move into the prediction markets sector. This deal signals Robinhood's intent to expand its crypto ecosystem and integrate betting/prediction capabilities.

Circle has agreed to acquire Singapore-based Tazapay to enhance the cross-border payment capabilities of USDC. The acquisition expands Circle's reach to over 100 markets and adds more than 60 banking and fintech partners.
Bitmine has purchased an additional 28,000 ETH, valued at approximately $69 million. This acquisition brings the company to 97% of its strategic goal to accumulate 5% of the total Ether supply.

Strategy has repurchased $176 million of its STRC preferred shares and expanded its digital securities repurchase program to $2 billion. Consequently, the company has paused its acquisition of new Bitcoin.

Berlin-based fintech Limetax has raised €36 million to expand its AI-powered rollup strategy for tax advisory firms. The company aims to continue acquiring firms to consolidate the tax advisory market.
Capital B has increased its Bitcoin holdings by purchasing an additional 376 BTC. This acquisition brings the company's total holdings to 3,521 BTC.

Antarctic Exchange, a high-performance decentralized perpetuals exchange, has successfully raised $7 million in funding. The round was supported by investors including Valisa Capital Markets, Lucidity Capital, and Republic Crypto.

on_the_radar.title: Tether, Fasanara launch $400M private credit fund targeting $3B 28m
on_the_radar.summary: Tether and Fasanara have launched a private credit fund with an initial $400 million investment, aiming to scale up to $3 billion. The fund focuses on providing credit to underserved markets and diversifying Tether's reserve assets.

on_the_radar.title: Visa brings onchain credit to its growing stablecoin card business39m
on_the_radar.summary: Visa is integrating onchain credit capabilities into its stablecoin card business to expand financial utility. This move aims to bridge traditional credit mechanisms with blockchain-based payment rails.

on_the_radar.title: Bitmine nears 5% of Ethereum supply after buying 28,086 ETH
on_the_radar.summary: Bitmine has significantly increased its Ethereum holdings by purchasing an additional 28,086 ETH. The company's treasury now holds 5.93 million tokens, accounting for approximately 4.9% of the total Ethereum supply.

on_the_radar.title: Citi, DBS complete first weekend tokenized cross-border deposit on Swift
on_the_radar.summary: Citi and DBS have successfully completed the first weekend cross-border deposit using Swift's blockchain ledger. This milestone demonstrates how tokenization can bypass traditional banking hours to enable 24/7 settlement.

on_the_radar.title: Harmony proposes shutting down layer 1, migrating ONE to Ethereum24m, Harmony proposes shutting down layer 1, migrating ONE to EthereumHarmony proposed sunsetting its layer-1 blockchain and migrating ONE to Ethereum, weeks after an exploit led to plans to discard 109,000 transactions.
on_the_radar.summary: Harmony has proposed shutting down its native layer-1 blockchain and migrating the ONE token to Ethereum. This move follows a recent exploit that necessitated the discarding of over 100,000 transactions.

on_the_radar.title: Revolut says customer KYC, Bitcoin transaction data exposed after fake request from gov't domain
on_the_radar.summary: Revolut reported a data breach where customer KYC and Bitcoin transaction data were exposed due to a fraudulent request appearing to come from a government domain. Onchain investigator ZachXBT suggests the attack may have specifically targeted high-net-worth individuals.

on_the_radar.title: UniCredit seeks infrastructure partner for crypto trading, custody: Report
on_the_radar.summary: UniCredit is reportedly searching for an infrastructure partner to enable crypto trading and custody services for its clients. This move signals a significant step toward integrating digital asset services into a major European banking institution.

on_the_radar.title: India launches tokenized bond pilot with $107M issued
on_the_radar.summary: India has launched the Demat 2.0 pilot program to settle and service $107 million in tokenized corporate bonds. The initiative leverages distributed ledger technology (DLT), wholesale CBDCs, and smart contracts to modernize bond issuance.

on_the_radar.title: ESMA says major prediction platforms lack EU authorization, questions Polymarket and Kalshi's partial geo-blocks
on_the_radar.summary: The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has stated that major prediction markets, including Polymarket and Kalshi, are operating without necessary EU authorization. The regulator specifically questioned the effectiveness of the platforms' partial geographic blocks intended to restrict EU users.

on_the_radar.title: ESMA warns growing crypto ties could amplify risks to traditional finance11m
on_the_radar.summary: The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has issued a warning regarding the increasing interconnectedness between crypto-assets and traditional financial systems. The regulator suggests that these ties could amplify systemic risks and potentially destabilize traditional finance during market volatility.

on_the_radar.title: UK House of Lords backs mandatory digital asset strategy over Labour position20m, UK House of Lords backs mandatory digital asset strategy over Labour positionThe amendment would require the UK Treasury to develop a strategy covering cryptoassets, stablecoins, tokenized securities and digital financial infrastructure.
on_the_radar.summary: The UK House of Lords has supported an amendment requiring the Treasury to create a mandatory digital asset strategy. This strategy would encompass cryptoassets, stablecoins, tokenized securities, and digital financial infrastructure, pushing for a more structured approach than the current Labour position.

on_the_radar.title: MoneyGram launches Visa stablecoin card as remittance rivals expand25m
on_the_radar.summary: MoneyGram has launched a stablecoin-powered card in partnership with Visa to enhance its remittance services. This move signals a strategic shift toward integrating digital assets into traditional cross-border payment infrastructures.

worth_a_read.note: Delphi Digital's examination of MetaDAO's post-token sale mechanics provides a necessary counterweight to the hype cycle around governance-minimized coordination experiments.

worth_a_read.title: MetaDAO: Built for the Next ICO Boom
worth_a_read.note: Messari's complementary take on MetaDAO's ICO readiness is worth pairing with the Delphi piece to stress-test whether the infrastructure can survive a speculative boom without collapsing.

linkedin_post:
Nasdaq just paid $100 million for a piece of Kraken at $21 billion. That is not a crypto trade. That is an exchange incumbent pricing in the replacement of its own clearing infrastructure.

We have seen this before. The question is what gets repriced first: the traditional rails or the tokenized alternatives. SEBI's Demat 2.0 pilot in India just crossed $100 million in corporate bonds settled on a wholesale CBDC. No retail speculation. Three issuers, regulated pipeline, working template. The contrast with Liquid's $320 million exploit and Blockstream's refusal to pay ransom is stark. One market is building plumbing. The other is still patching leaks.

The CLARITY Act vote this week could sharpen the divergence. 635 pages, ethics provisions, a procedural deadline. If it moves, US custody and exchange infrastructure gets repriced within the quarter. If it stalls, the capital formation edge shifts further to jurisdictions that have already shipped working pilots.

We are underwriting tokenization infrastructure on whether regulated wholesale demand converts to recurring fee streams, not on whether retail ever arrives. The test: does Nasdaq's Kraken bet generate tokenized stock volume that competes with its own listings, or does it sit as strategic option value? Same question for SEBI's pilot. Scale without speculation is the harder and more valuable path.

We will know the thesis is wrong if Q3 shows these pilots stalling while memecoin infrastructure recovers faster.
